title: The Giving Tree
author: Shel Silverstein
summary: A tree loves a boy and gives him her apples, branches and trunk as he grows from child to old man. A very short picture book about giving, taking and what is left at the end.
readIf: you want a quiet fable to read aloud that leaves room to talk about generosity.
skipIf: you want a story with a clear, cheerful lesson rather than an ambiguous, bittersweet one.
